hero.title: Money, workouts and meals in one place
hero.subtitle: Helemy tracks your spending, budgets, workouts and nutrition, alone or together with your household, on your computer and phone.

modules.title: Everything you track, in one app
modules.subtitle: Instead of five different apps and spreadsheets, one place for your whole day.

finances.title: Finances
finances.text: Accounts, transactions, transfers, budgets and reports. Always know what you have and where the money goes.

fitness.title: Fitness
fitness.text: Workouts, exercises and sets, with last time's result and the progress of every exercise.

nutrition.title: Nutrition
nutrition.text: A meal diary with calories and macros, and a food database with values per 100 g.

household.title: Household
household.text: Invite the people you live with and keep finances, workouts and nutrition together, in one household.

account.title: Create an account
account.text: Signing up takes a minute; you get default categories and your first account right away.

track.title: Log your day
track.text: Add expenses, workouts and meals as they happen, from your computer or phone.

progress.title: Follow your progress
progress.text: Budgets, reports and charts show where you are and where you're heading.

cta.title: Ready to start?
cta.text: Create an account and keep your finances, training and nutrition under control.

about.title: About
about.text: Helemy was made so that money, training and nutrition live in one place, simply and without ads.

contact.title: Contact
contact.text: Questions, ideas or a bug to report? Write to us:

errors.network: The server isn't reachable. Check your connection and try again.
errors.throttled: Too many attempts. Wait a little and try again.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong (status {{status}}). Please try again.

image.cropHint: Drag the picture and set the zoom so the frame covers what you want.
image.wrongType: Choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.
image.tooLarge: The picture is too large (at most 30 MB).

validation.passwordMin: The password must have at least {{min}} characters.
validation.amount: Enter an amount above zero, at most two decimals (e.g. 1250.50).
validation.endBeforeStart: The end can't be before the start.

forgot.title: Forgotten password
forgot.intro: Enter your account's email and we'll send you a link to set a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account with that email exists, we've sent a link. It's valid for one hour.

reset.title: New password
reset.done: Your password has been changed. Log in with the new password.
reset.invalidLink: The link is invalid or has expired.

verify.title: Email confirmation
verify.missingToken: The link is incomplete. Open it again from the email.
verify.newLinkHint: Log in: if the address isn't confirmed yet, you can ask for a new link there.
verify.checkText: We sent a confirmation link to {{email}}. Open it to finish signing up; it's valid for 48 hours.
verify.notVerified: Your email address isn't confirmed yet. Open the link we sent you or ask for a new one.
verify.resent: We sent a new link. If you don't see it, check your spam folder too.

members.title: Members
members.leaveInfo: When you leave, you become the owner of your personal household again, with the data you had there. What you entered here stays with this household.

invite.title: Invite members
invite.intro: Invite someone who already has an account. They'll see the invitation when they log in.

received.title: Invitations for you
received.warning: If you accept, you move to that household. Your current household is kept with all its data, and you return to it if you leave.

profile.title: Profile
profile.currencyInfo: The currency only changes how amounts are shown; they aren't converted. The time zone is only stored for now.

password.title: Change password
password.info: After the change you'll be logged out on all other devices.
password.changed: Your password has been changed. Other devices have been logged out.

profile.weightUnitInfo: Training totals are shown in this unit; exercises in the other unit are converted. New exercises get it by default.

transactions.byCategoryHint: Click a category to see its transactions.

categories.intro: Categories are grouped. A transaction can only use a category that is active on its date.
categories.name: Name
categories.deleteGroupConfirm: Delete the group and all its categories?
categories.groupInUse: The group has categories with transactions and can't be deleted. Switch it off instead.
categories.categoryInUse: The category has transactions and can't be deleted. Switch it off instead.
categories.periodHelp: Optional: the category is valid only between these dates (e.g. a trip, a renovation).
categories.yearlyHelp: Optional: the category is valid every year in this window (e.g. heating from 15 October to 15 April).
categories.monthAndDay: Choose both the month and the day, or neither.
categories.invalidDay: That month has no such day.
categories.transferHint: Transfers between accounts go here. The category can be renamed or moved to another group, but it's always on.

budgets.overlap: This category already has a budget overlapping the chosen period.

reports.byGroupHint: Click a group to see its categories.
reports.balanceHint: Balance at the end of each day: the accounts' opening balance plus every change.

accounts.name: Name (e.g. Current account, Cash, Savings)
accounts.openingHint: Money the account held apart from the transactions you record in the app (e.g. when you started using it). Balance = opening balance + all transactions and transfers, including ones older than this date.
accounts.isActive: Active (switch off when you close the account; it stays in history)
accounts.noneActive: There is no active account. Create one first.
accounts.inUse: The account has transactions or transfers, so it can't be deleted. Switch it off (Active) so it's no longer offered.

transfers.hint: Moving money between your accounts (e.g. a cash withdrawal). It makes two linked transactions, out and in: they change the two accounts' balances, but don't count as income or expenses.

validation.weight: Weight with up to two decimals (e.g. 82.5), or empty.

trainings.deleteConfirm: Delete the whole training with all its sets?
trainings.muscleGroupsHint: With groups chosen, only their exercises are offered. Without, all exercises are.
trainings.removeExerciseConfirm: Remove the exercise and all its sets from this training?
trainings.noExercisesLeft: No more exercises for the chosen muscle groups.
trainings.weightHint: Leave the weight empty for bodyweight exercises (pull-ups, push-ups).

exercises.empty: No exercises yet. Add the first one.
exercises.inUse: The exercise is used in trainings, so it can't be deleted (its history would be lost).
exercises.weightUnitHint: As on the machine: this exercise's sets are entered and shown in this unit.
exercises.weightUnitChange: Existing sets keep their numbers; they will just be shown in {{unit}}.

progress.title: Progress
progress.empty: This exercise isn't in any of your trainings yet.

validation.calories: Enter a whole number from 0 to 900.
validation.macro: Enter a whole number from 0 to 100.
validation.pickFood: Pick a food from the list.

diary.macros: P {{protein}} g · C {{carbs}} g · F {{fat}} g

foods.empty: No foods yet. Add the first one.
foods.per100Hint: Values per 100 g (as on the label)
foods.inUse: This food is in the diary and can't be deleted.
